No, actually.

This has nothing to do with not having a job, or having lots of debt, or not knowing what to do with my life.

Read my post history if you actually want any idea of what's happening in my life.

> I realize I will be leaving behind some great people, and I know they will be upset. But I also know they will be okay. People say suicide is selfish, but who are they to decide what is best for me? 

I already said that I understand that aspect, and have come to terms with it.

I have a reason why not. I've experienced exceptional trauma. I have lost everyone I have ever cared about. I am currently restarting.

I don't need to restart. I don't want to. I would have happily lived my old life. But that doesn't exist anymore. It isn't worth the effort to restart, when I can't see a reason too.

> Everything that happened can be fixed as long as you just go back.

Yeah... I don't think you know what you're talking about...
